segments.line: Everyone's phone has turned into a camera with a flashlight.
Before that flight, you didn't just download music. You downloaded the whole of Wikipedia.
Almost seven million articles, with pictures, about a hundred gigabytes.
You did it because you were bored.
Now you're carrying the biggest library in town in your pocket.
How to purify water. How to treat a burn. How to fix an engine. How to grow potatoes.
Word gets around. People knock on your door with questions, and you read them the answers.
The farmer down the road. A nurse. A guy whose solar panels won't talk to his battery anymore.
You start writing the answers on paper, and pinning them to the library door.
A little boy asks how to make his grandad's old radio work. You find the page, and ten minutes later it crackles to life.
Then, on the seventh evening, a black car pulls up outside. There's no traffic anymore, so you hear it from three streets away.
A man in a grey suit gets out.
His shoes are clean. Nobody's shoes are clean anymore.
He doesn't knock. He just waits until you open the door.
'You're the kid with the encyclopedia, ' he says. 'We'd like to borrow it.
He smiles. 'The people trying to keep the lights on. '
